snippet.title: COLORMUSE - Stylish twin-stick shooter, led by two colorful divas.
snippet.description:
COLORMUSE — is a stylish twin-stick shooter starring two muses of grace and color — Staccato and Legato. Just as their jazz concert is about to begin, chaos erupts: out-of-tune instruments crash the stage, drowning the harmony in noise!

Swap colors on the fly, absorb matching bullets to power up your attacks, and dodge the rest in this high-octane arena shooter!

Inspired by the polarity mechanics of Ikaruga and the visceral feel of Nuclear Throne, COLORMUSE turns bullet hell into a dance — and you're leading.

FEATURES:

    High-octane arcade shooter action - with a colorful twist: absorb bullets of your color to gain power!
    Combo chaining system!
    Starring two vibrant muses — the fiery, impulsive Staccato, and the elegant, poised Legato!
    Difficulty modes - tackle Normal Mode for the core experience — or dive into LUNATIC Mode, a brutal gauntlet for the most manic shooting game diehards.
    Amazing music by talents such as Cadmium and つよみー (Tsuyomi)
    Online leaderboard!
    High refresh rate support!
